**Implementation note:** Queue-position fill model only (needs L2).

## Description

Conditions quote placement and order sizing on current queue/depth state and the probability of queue depletion or adverse price movement.

## Where it may fit

Tick-level order-driven markets where queue priority and order-book state affect fills and short-term price formation.

## Vehicles

HFT and professional electronic market making.

## Required data

Level-2 or full depth book updates, order-level queue position if available, trades/cancellations, latency and exchange fee schedule.

## Caveats

Top-of-book bars are insufficient to simulate queue priority; realism requires exchange rules, partial fills, cancel latency and adverse-selection costs.
